youtube_description: By the year 2030, the Delphi method has evolved into a fully autonomous, AI-based system that is capable of independently identifying and convening experts from various fields globally. The AI analyzes their opinions and creates summaries using advanced algorithms that understand the complex dynamics between expert discourses. This autonomy enables faster and more objective consensus decisions without human editor biases.
